title: Spacex Cargo Resupply Ship Departs Space Station For Home – Friday, May 23, 2025
description: Loaded with scientific experiments and supplies, an unpiloted SpaceX Dragon undocked from the International Space Station May 23, completing a month-long mission to the outpost for the company’s 32nd commercial resupply services mission for NASA. The SpaceX Dragon undocked from the zenith port of the Harmony module, headed for a splashdown off the coast of Florida May 25 to complete its flight that delivered several tons of experiments and hardware to the station.   Join NASA as we go forward to the Moon and on to Mars -- discover the latest on Earth, the Solar System and beyond with a weekly update in your inbox.  Subscribe at: https://www.nasa.gov/subscribe
keywords: Expedition 73, SpaceX Cargo Resupply Ship Undocking
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
